name: setup-check
description: Proves a machine can run real pipelines: a zero-token code step, one small agent call on Haiku through the Claude Agent SDK, and a check that fails the run unless the agent answered. Used by /sammy-pack-setup; costs a fraction of a cent.

phases.name: agent
phases.prompt: This is a setup check. Reply with the single line SETUP-OK and nothing else.

code.source: if (!String(input).includes('SETUP-OK')) throw new Error('the agent did not answer SETUP-OK; it said: ' + String(input).slice(0, 200)); return 'agent ok'
